description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint used within the OrangeHRM system to provide summaries of employee attendance. It handles GET requests, processes query parameters such as date ranges and employee IDs, and retrieves summarized attendance data from the data access object. It also includes validation rules for request parameters and integrates with other system services via traits and dependencies.
